archetypes.name: dyn-schema-provenance
archetypes.rationale: Strict JSONL schema evolution and legacy marking require compatibility scrutiny.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the triage and verifier parsers plus ledger serialization. Verify that only exact prior or current shapes ingest, current claims require coherent evidence, and legacy persisted rows cannot appear as current claims. Check refresh behavior clears invalidated deep provenance. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
